description: This file defines classes and functions for managing autograd anomaly detection in PyTorch, including context managers to enable or disable anomaly detection and check for NaN values during backward passes.

classes.name: detect_anomaly
classes.description: Context manager to enable autograd anomaly detection, with options to check for NaN values during backward passes.

classes.name: set_detect_anomaly
classes.description: Context manager to set autograd anomaly detection on or off based on a boolean mode.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the context manager, saving previous anomaly detection states and optionally enabling detection.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enables anomaly detection when entering the context.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Restores previous anomaly detection states when exiting the context.
